title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 3: Yahweh calls the boy Samuel in the night and gives him a message about Eli's house.

questions.text: What does the chapter say about Yahweh's word in those days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word was rare in those days; there were not many visions then.

questions.text: Where was Samuel lying down when Yahweh called him?
questions.explanation: Samuel had laid down in Yahweh's temple where God's ark was.

answers.text: In Yahweh's temple where God's ark was
In his father's house in Ramah
At the gate of the city

questions.text: What did Samuel do the first time Yahweh called him?
questions.explanation: He ran to Eli and said, "Here I am; for you called me."

answers.text: He stayed silent in his bed

questions.text: At which call did Eli realize that Yahweh was calling the child?
questions.explanation: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time, and Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.

questions.text: What did Eli tell Samuel to say if he was called again?
questions.explanation: Eli told him to say, "Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears."

answers.text: "Who are you, my lord, and what do you want?"
"Go and speak to Eli the priest instead."

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would happen to the ears of everyone who heard of what he would do?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh say he would judge Eli's house?
questions.explanation: His sons brought a curse on themselves, and Eli knew it but didn't restrain them.

answers.text: Eli did not restrain his sons
Eli had moved the ark from Shiloh
Eli had refused to teach Samuel

questions.text: How did Samuel feel about showing Eli the vision in the morning?
questions.explanation: Samuel lay until the morning and opened the doors of Yahweh's house; he was afraid to show Eli the vision.

questions.text: What did Eli say after Samuel told him everything?
questions.explanation: Eli said, "It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him."

answers.text: "You must have been dreaming, my son."
"Do not tell this to anyone in Israel."
"It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him."
"Go home to your mother in Ramah."

questions.text: Who knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.

answers.text: All Israel from Dan to Beersheba
